tooltip.industrialcrops.empty_bag: Use on mature industrial carrots or potatoes to harvest one bagged crop and reset growth. Other mature industrial crops yield only 3–6 seeds once.
tooltip.industrialcrops.fertilizer_fast_: Right-click an industrial crop to finish its growth instantly.
tooltip.industrialcrops.fertilizer_ferti: Right-click farmland to convert it into fertile soil. Industrial crop harvests are doubled.
tooltip.industrialcrops.feed_bag.basic: Use on an adult animal to enter breeding mode.
tooltip.industrialcrops.feed_bag.healing: Rapidly restores an animal's health and grants regeneration.
tooltip.industrialcrops.feed_bag.growth: Instantly grows a baby animal into an adult.
tooltip.industrialcrops.feed_bag.fast_br: Resets breeding cooldown and enters breeding mode.

tooltip.industrialcrops.function.basic_c: Insert a vanilla crop, Redstone Bonemeal, and an Empty Bag when required to convert it into the matching industrial crop; supports pipes and speed components.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.crop_co: Insert 64 matching industrial crops to compress them into one corresponding crop block; supports pipes and speed components.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.crop_an: Insert an industrial crop or seed bag to inspect its dominant and recessive gene qualities without consuming it.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.gourd_m: Insert SUPER-quality Industrial Melon and Industrial Pumpkin to create a Fusion Melon; supports hoppers, pipes, and speed components.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.fusion_: Automatically uses Fortune III on ores and Silk Touch on other blocks; it can mine naturally generated unbreakable blocks but refuses command and other admin blocks.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.mixer: Insert valid ingredients and an Empty Bag by hand, hopper, or pipe to mix them; use an empty hand to retrieve all contents.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.fertile: Grow industrial crops on it for double yield; it never dries out or reverts to dirt when water is absent.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.basic_s: Connect it beside a Basic Control Device or another connected component to store industrial crops; breaking it preserves its contents.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.basic_c: Connect adjacent or continuously linked Basic Storage Components to access their industrial crops from one interface.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.reinfor: Connect it beside a Reinforced Control Device or another linked component for 54 oversized-stack slots; breaking it preserves its contents.
Connect adjacent or continuously linked Reinforced Storage Components and manage their items through scrollable pages.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.advance: Install Industrial Storage Components to unlock storage pages for storing, searching, and crafting with large item collections; supports pipes.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.basic_m: Open its interface, select an output, and insert the requested materials to make iron and reinforced devices or pipes; upgrade it with a Gold Upgrade Kit.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.gold_up: Right-click a Basic Manipulation Device to upgrade it into an Advanced Manipulation Device while keeping its facing.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.advance: Open its interface, select an output, and insert the requested materials to make reinforced devices, gold network machines, and advanced pipes.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.process: Insert a Component Substrate and the matching materials to automatically make guidance, storage, launcher, and speed components; accepts speed upgrades.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.automat: Automatically plants crop seeds from its seed slots or adjacent containers on valid farmland in its own chunk and the eight neighboring chunks.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.pipe_so: Connects to the pipe network, filters items with a whitelist or blacklist, and routes them to adjacent inventories.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.matter_: Insert an allowed item to digitize and upload it to a connected Item Network Management Terminal.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.digitiz: Select item data in the network terminal and consume FE to add one copy of that data.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.matter_: Select item data in the network terminal and consume FE to reconstruct it as a physical item.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.item_ne: Connect matter devices to store, select, and manage digitized items.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.bio_ene: Insert industrial biomass to generate FE while accumulating residue that must be sent to a Residue Incinerator.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.energy_: Connect FE devices or energy cables to store FE and configure output sides.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.residue: Insert any furnace fuel to destroy residue from adjacent or pipe-connected generators.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.electri: Insert up to three smeltable stacks and supply FE to run three fast smelting lanes at once.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.digital: Connect an item network and select a digitized sapling to periodically generate digitized logs of that tree type.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.basic_e: Connect FE devices to transfer energy automatically between adjacent endpoints.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.advance: Connect FE devices to transfer energy automatically between adjacent endpoints at higher bandwidth.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.slime_c: Use it on an industrial slime to capture it. Once placed, release the slime or consume copper, iron, gold, or diamond ore to convert it into the matching industrial slime.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.slime_i: Insert a converter containing a captured slime or a slime spawn egg to cultivate the matching industrial slime and collect its products from the output slot.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.explosi: Set an absolute or relative target, load Explosive Potatoes, and launch; accepts guidance, rapid-fire, and power components.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.basic_p: Connect output pipes to input pipes to form an item transport network.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.reinfor: Connect output pipes to input pipes to form a high-speed item transport network.
tooltip.industrialcrops.function.advance: Connect output pipes to input pipes to form an advanced item transport network.

tooltip.industrialcrops.function.gold_fl: Connects fluid machines and automatically routes fluid to compatible tanks.
